claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria was born c. 185 and died c. 254.
Origen was the most important theologian and biblical scholar of the early Greek church.
Origen was born at Alexandria of Christian parents.
Origen became head of the Catechetical School of Alexandria, first informally, then officially in 203.
Some material attributed to Origen in Patrologia Graeca 17:149-252 has been shown to be derived from the Scholia on Proverbs of Evagrius Ponticus.
The commentary series on Proverbs 30:15-31 was reconstructed by Marcel Richard from the catena of Procopius.
The fragments preserve Origen's broad theological hermeneutic and his treatment of the Book of Proverbs as a whole.
The fragments contain material with Stoic analogies and preserve key motifs of Patristic exegesis.
